# mdpeek

> Fast, text-first Markdown viewer for the terminal, written in Rust. Body text is real terminal text (selectable, copyable); local images are drawn with kitty, sixel or iTerm2 graphics where supported and shown as `[image: alt]` placeholders elsewhere, including tmux. Linux, macOS and Windows. One static binary, no network access. MIT licensed.

Install on macOS/Linux: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2790karthikbhat/mdpeek/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`
Install on Windows (PowerShell): `irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2790karthikbhat/mdpeek/main/scripts/install.ps1 | iex`
Install with Rust: `cargo install mdpeek`. Verify: `mdpeek --version`.
Non-interactive use (agents, scripts, CI): `mdpeek --plain --color never FILE`.
